lines.zh: 发出低沉的嘶嘶声，向前蠕动.
lines.en: makes a low hiss and crawls forward.

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，双螯轻轻触碰地面.
lines.en: moves slowly, its claws lightly tap the ground.

lines.zh: 腹部轻轻触碰地面，缓慢爬行.
lines.en: touches the ground with its abdomen and crawls slowly.

lines.zh: 伸展触手，缓慢移动.
lines.en: stretches its tentacles and moves slowly.

lines.zh: 挥动双螯，寻找猎物.
lines.en: waves its claws, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 腹部起伏，缓慢前行.
lines.en: abdomen rises and falls as it moves slowly.

lines.zh: 缓慢挪动，双螯轻微敲击.
lines.en: moves slowly, its claws tapping lightly.

lines.zh: 双螯微微动弹，缓慢挪动.
lines.en: claws move slightly as it crawls slowly.

lines.zh: 腹部轻轻触地，缓慢前进.
lines.en: abdomen touches the ground as it moves slowly.

lines.zh: 触手轻微挥动，缓慢爬行.
lines.en: tentacles gently move, crawling slowly.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，倒着爬。
lines.en: Eyes on you, I crawl backward.

lines.zh: 我贴着阴影的边缘移动。
lines.en: I move along the edge of the shadow.

lines.zh: 我忽然停住，又忽然狂奔。
lines.en: I stop dead, then bolt.

lines.zh: 我的肢节敲在地面上，很轻。
lines.en: My joints tap the floor, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我退进墙角，缩了起来。
lines.en: I back into the corner and shrink.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚边爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl right past your feet.

lines.zh: 静止不动，双螯轻微颤抖.
lines.en: pauses, its claws lightly trembling.

lines.zh: 双螯微微颤抖，腹部起伏.
lines.en: claws tremble slightly, abdomen rising and falling.

lines.zh: 腹部轻轻起伏，双螯微动.
lines.en: abdomen gently rises and falls, claws moving slightly.

lines.zh: 腹部轻轻蠕动，双螯轻微颤抖.
lines.en: abdomen gently moves, claws trembling slightly.

lines.zh: 双螯轻微颤抖，腹部起伏.
lines.en: claws tremble slightly, abdomen rising and falling.

lines.zh: 双螯微动，腹部轻轻蠕动.
lines.en: claws move slightly, abdomen gently moves.

lines.zh: 腹部起伏，双螯轻微颤抖.
lines.en: abdomen rises and falls, claws trembling slightly.

lines.zh: 双螯轻微颤动，腹部起伏.
lines.en: claws tremble slightly, abdomen rising and falling.

lines.zh: 腹部轻轻蠕动，双螯微动.
lines.en: abdomen gently moves, claws moving slightly.

lines.zh: 腹部轻微蠕动，双螯颤抖.
lines.en: abdomen gently moves, claws trembling.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，一动不动。
lines.en: I count your breaths and do not move.

lines.zh: 我的头慢慢偏了一点。
lines.en: My head tilts a fraction.

lines.zh: 迅速转向玩家，触手伸展.
lines.en: quickly turns to face the player, tentacles extending.

lines.zh: 双螯指向前方，凝视玩家.
lines.en: claws point forward, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 触手伸展，双螯指向玩家.
lines.en: tentacles extend, claws pointing at the player.

lines.zh: 双螯紧握，触手伸向玩家.
lines.en: claws grip, tentacles reaching towards the player.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕玩家，双螯紧握.
lines.en: tentacles wrap around the player, claws gripping.

lines.zh: 双螯指向玩家，触手逼近.
lines.en: claws point at the player, tentacles closing in.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕玩家，双螯紧贴.
lines.en: tentacles wrap around the player, claws pressing close.

lines.zh: 触手紧紧缠绕玩家，双螯紧握.
lines.en: tentacles tightly wrap around the player, claws gripping tightly.

lines.zh: 双螯紧贴玩家，触手迅速逼近.
lines.en: claws press close to the player, tentacles rapidly closing in.

lines.zh: 我发现你在看我。
lines.en: I realize you are looking at me.

lines.zh: 奄奄一息，快救我！
lines.en: Dying, save me!

lines.zh: 求求你，不要放弃我！
lines.en: Please, don't leave me!

lines.zh: 我好害怕，你能帮我吗？
lines.en: I'm scared, can you help me?

lines.zh: 快来救我，我已经不行了！
lines.en: Come save me, I'm dying!

lines.zh: 快救我，否则我就完了！
lines.en: Save me, or I'm done for!

lines.zh: 救救我，我快要死了！
lines.en: Save me, I'm nearly dead!

lines.zh: 求求你，不要让我死！
lines.en: Please, don't let me die!

lines.zh: 你来了我就好了！
lines.en: You're here, I'm okay!

lines.zh: 快点，我快要不行了！
lines.en: Hurry, I'm running out of time!

lines.zh: 救救我，我会感激你的！
lines.en: Save me, I'll be grateful!

lines.zh: 触碰我，你就死定了！
lines.en: Touch me, and you're doomed!

lines.zh: 退后，你身上的味道太重。
lines.en: Back off; your smell is too strong.

lines.zh: 别逼我攻击你！
lines.en: Don't force me to attack you!

lines.zh: 你靠近了！我要杀了你！
lines.en: You're getting closer! I'm going to kill you!

lines.zh: 快走开，否则你活不了！
lines.en: Get away, or you'll die!

lines.zh: 你触碰了我！我要吃了你！
lines.en: You touched me! I'm going to eat you!

lines.zh: 你在我视线里！
lines.en: You're in my sight!

lines.zh: 我饿了，我要吃你！
lines.en: I'm hungry, I'm going to eat you!

lines.zh: 不要过来，否则你会后悔！
lines.en: Don't come closer, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 你再往前，我就会扑上去。
lines.en: One more step and I will lunge.

lines.zh: 小心！我会撞死你！
lines.en: Watch out! I'll ram you to death!

lines.zh: 我来了，让你尝尝我的力量！
lines.en: Here I come, feel my power!

lines.zh: 让开，别站在我前面。
lines.en: Move; do not stand in front of me.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就跑吧。
lines.en: You saw me. Now run.

lines.zh: 你直视我，那我只能撞过来。
lines.en: You looked right at me, so I have to charge.

lines.zh: 我全速冲过来，不收脚。
lines.en: I come at full speed and will not slow.

lines.zh: 你阻止不了我！
lines.en: You can't stop me!

lines.zh: 别挡我的路，否则你会死！
lines.en: Don't block my path, or you'll die!

lines.zh: 我来了，你准备受死吧！
lines.en: Here I am, prepare to die!

lines.zh: 挡我路者，死！
lines.en: Those who block my path, die!

lines.zh: 快过来，我要交配！
lines.en: Come here, I want to mate!

lines.zh: 求你了，交配吧！
lines.en: Please, let's mate!

lines.zh: 我先靠近，再跟你谈。
lines.en: I come closer first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 你愿意和我交配吗？
lines.en: Will you mate with me?

lines.zh: 交配吧，这是你的机会！
lines.en: Mate with me, this is your chance!

lines.zh: 我等你很久了，快！
lines.en: I've waited for you long enough, now!

lines.zh: 我要交配，别躲！
lines.en: I want to mate, don't dodge!

lines.zh: 来吧，交配吧！
lines.en: Come on, let's mate!

lines.zh: 交配是我们的使命！
lines.en: Mating is our mission!

lines.zh: 求求你了，快交配！
lines.en: Please, hurry and mate!

lines.zh: 我闻到了你的恐惧！
lines.en: I smell your fear!

lines.zh: 别动，你动得越多，我越兴奋！
lines.en: Don't move, the more you move, the more excited I get!

lines.zh: 这是你的恐惧，我最喜欢的味道！
lines.en: This is your fear, my favorite taste!

lines.zh: 品尝恐惧的滋味吧！
lines.en: Taste the flavor of fear!

lines.zh: 你的恐惧已经足够了，该你了。
lines.en: Enough fear, it's your turn now.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你会得到更多！
lines.en: Come closer, you'll get more!

lines.zh: 你害怕了吗？
lines.en: Are you scared now?

lines.zh: 你尝过恐惧的味道吗？
lines.en: Have you tasted fear?

lines.zh: 恐惧就是我的食物！
lines.en: Fear is my food!

lines.zh: 你注定成为我的猎物！
lines.en: You are destined to be my prey!

lines.zh: 你的视线落在我身上了。
lines.en: Your gaze has landed on me.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就别喘了。
lines.en: You saw me. Now stop breathing.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会找到你的！
lines.en: You can't escape, I'll find you!

lines.zh: 你看了我一眼，现在轮到我了。
lines.en: You looked at me once; now it is my turn.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，我已经锁定你了！
lines.en: You can't escape, I've got you locked on!

lines.zh: 你跑不了，我已经发现你了！
lines.en: You can't run, I've found you!

lines.zh: 我已经盯上你了，别想逃跑！
lines.en: I've got you in my sights, don't try to run!

lines.zh: 我不会轻易放弃的！
lines.en: I won't give up easily!

lines.zh: 我已经发现了你，你逃不掉！
lines.en: I've found you, you can't escape!

lines.zh: 你已经逃不掉了！
lines.en: You can't escape now!

lines.zh: 你多看了我一眼。
lines.en: You looked at me one time too many.

lines.zh: 我把你的注视当成挑衅。
lines.en: I take your stare as a challenge.

lines.zh: 你看了我一眼，我就冲过来。
lines.en: One glance from you and I charge.

lines.zh: 我已经数到你的第三步。
lines.en: I have counted to your third step.

lines.zh: 我要开始攻击了！
lines.en: I'm about to attack!

lines.zh: 我来了，躲开吧！
lines.en: I'm coming, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 我要攻击你了！
lines.en: I'm attacking you!

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准你了！
lines.en: I'm targeting you!

lines.zh: 你准备好迎接我的攻击了吗？
lines.en: Are you ready for my attack?

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准你了，小心！
lines.en: I'm targeting you, be careful!

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就不用再躲。
lines.en: You saw me, so no more hiding.

lines.zh: 我已经瞄准你了，准备迎接命运吧！
lines.en: I'm targeting you, prepare for your fate!

lines.zh: 我全身绷紧，准备冲来。
lines.en: My whole body tenses to charge.

lines.zh: 我把距离缩到了一步。
lines.en: I close the distance to one step.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，你周围弥漫着腐烂的气息。
lines.en: Sibilant hiss, a stench of decay lingers.

lines.zh: 触角颤动，逼近你的身影。
lines.en: Antennae quiver, inching closer.

lines.zh: 眼睛闪烁，你的每一次呼吸都威胁着我。
lines.en: Eyes gleam, each breath a threat.

lines.zh: 咬下一口，腐肉的味道在口中弥漫。
lines.en: Bite down, a taste of decay.

lines.zh: 你的血液，是我唯一的猎物。
lines.en: Your blood, my only prey.

lines.zh: 触须缠绕，你无法逃脱。
lines.en: Tentacles wrap, escape denied.

lines.zh: 腐化的触手紧抓，感受到你的痛苦。
lines.en: Corrupted tendrils grasp, savouring your pain.

lines.zh: 血液涌出，腐烂的气息更加浓烈。
lines.en: Blood spurts, the stench grows stronger.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕，你无法呼吸。
lines.en: Tentacles ensnare, choking you.

lines.zh: 腐化的触手撕裂你的肌肤。
lines.en: Rotted tentacles tear your flesh.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，一个模糊的身影出现。
lines.en: A shadow appears in the darkness.

lines.zh: 腐化的阴影，在夜幕下凝结。
lines.en: Corrupted shadow coalesces under the night.

lines.zh: 一股寒意，从你的背后升起。
lines.en: A chill rises from behind you.

lines.zh: 腐化的声音，在空无一物中回荡。
lines.en: A corrupted voice echoes, empty.

lines.zh: 你周围，一个扭曲的身影显现。
lines.en: A twisted figure appears around you.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，一个幽灵般的存在。
lines.en: A spectral presence in the dark.

lines.zh: 腐化的光芒，照亮了你的道路。
lines.en: Corrupted light guides your path.

lines.zh: 腐化的阴影，悄然而至。
lines.en: A corrupted shadow approaches silently.

lines.zh: 你感到，有东西在注视着你。
lines.en: You feel watched by something.

lines.zh: 你转身，一个腐化的身影就在那里。
lines.en: You turn, a corrupted figure awaits.

lines.zh: 火在烧我的肢节…
lines.en: Fire burns through my joints...

lines.zh: 摔下来，壳裂了…
lines.en: I fell, and my shell split...

lines.zh: 水淹上来，我喘不了…
lines.en: Water rises, and I cannot breathe...

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被撒开了…
lines.en: A blast scatters me apart...

lines.zh: 一根箭钉穿了我…
lines.en: An arrow pins right through me...

lines.zh: 光钻进我的身体…
lines.en: Light worms into my body...

lines.zh: 我连恐惧都吃不到了…
lines.en: I cannot even feed on fear now...

lines.zh: 雷光烧穿了我的影子…
lines.en: Lightning burns through my shadow...

lines.zh: 虚空把我一点点抹掉…
lines.en: The void erases me bit by bit...
